blocks.text: We are a few weeks into the Walker-Murray work and tracking to the plan we set at kickoff. James Green has built the first cut of the cost and margin model for {{fact:f:E-2022-001.client}}, and the baseline reconciles against the figures your finance team sent, which is a good sign this early. The operating-model interviews are booked through the end of next week, and the early pattern is holding: the margin gap is real and it is not spread evenly across the business.

One item is open on your side. We still need the plant-level cost detail for the two largest sites; the site-level cut is what tells us whether the margin gap is broad across the business or sitting in a handful of lines, and that difference changes what we end up recommending. We can keep moving on the business totals for now, but the site detail is the piece that turns a direction into a recommendation. If your team can send it by the end of next week we hold the schedule, and if it will take longer, tell me and we will resequence the analysis around it.

For the first full working session, our side will be Jason Torres, James Green, and me, Melissa Casey; on yours, we would want you, James Keller, and whoever owns the plant data. I will send two or three proposed times tomorrow so your office can hold the slots, and an hour should be enough for this first one.
